regex: password authentication failed|FATAL:.*authentication|access denied for user|Authentication failed.*(mongo|postgres|mysql)
signal: Backend reached the database host but credentials were rejected.
likelyCauses: Wrong DB username/password in env/config
Credentials rotated but not updated in this environment
Wrong DB name/user pair for this environment (e.g. prod creds used against staging DB)

candidateFixes.label: Update the DB credential env var(s) for this environment
candidateFixes.tradeoff: Config-only change; ask which value(s) are stale.

candidateFixes.label: Point the connection string at the correct DB/user pair
candidateFixes.tradeoff: Config-only change; confirm the correct target first.

candidateFixes.label: Regenerate/rotate the DB credential and update the secret store
candidateFixes.tradeoff: Bigger change, touches secret management — needs explicit sign-off.

signal: Database (or a dependency) is not reachable from the backend process.
likelyCauses: DB container/service not running
Wrong host/port in connection string
Backend started before DB finished initializing
Network/firewall rule blocking the port

candidateFixes.label: Restart the DB service and re-run
candidateFixes.tradeoff: No code change; only fixes it if the DB was simply down.

candidateFixes.label: Fix the host/port in the connection string/env var
candidateFixes.tradeoff: Config change — confirm the correct value before editing.

candidateFixes.label: Add a startup retry/backoff to the DB client
candidateFixes.tradeoff: Real code/behavior change; review before applying, prevents future start-order races.

regex: no such table|relation ".*" does not exist|Table '.*' doesn't exist|Unknown collection
signal: Expected schema object is missing — migrations likely haven't run against this DB.
likelyCauses: Migrations not applied in this environment
Pointed at the wrong database (e.g. a fresh/empty one)
Migration failed partway through silently

candidateFixes.label: Run the pending migrations
candidateFixes.tradeoff: Standard fix; confirm which migration tool/command before running it — this is a Zone B action, needs approval.

candidateFixes.label: Re-point config at the correct DB
candidateFixes.tradeoff: Config-only, if this was just the wrong target.

candidateFixes.label: Investigate why a migration failed silently
candidateFixes.tradeoff: Deeper dig, not a quick fix — flag as blocked if time-boxed.

signal: Backend returned 500 where the smoke test expected success or a clean 4xx.
likelyCauses: Unhandled exception in the request handler
Missing/invalid config or env var for this route's dependency
Contract drift — request shape changed but handler wasn't updated

candidateFixes.label: Add proper error handling so this returns a clean 4xx/5xx with a message
candidateFixes.tradeoff: Improves robustness; doesn't fix the underlying trigger, just the failure mode.

candidateFixes.label: Fix the root cause named in the accompanying stack trace
candidateFixes.tradeoff: Direct fix; needs the specific trace to identify — ask if not already captured.

candidateFixes.label: Roll back the change that introduced this if it's a regression
candidateFixes.tradeoff: Fast mitigation; defers the real fix.

signal: A call expected to succeed with valid test credentials was rejected as unauthorized.
likelyCauses: Test credentials expired or were never seeded in this environment
Token not being attached/forwarded correctly
Auth middleware change broke a previously-valid token format

candidateFixes.label: Re-seed or refresh the smoke-test fixture account
candidateFixes.tradeoff: No code change; only fixes it if credentials were the issue.

candidateFixes.label: Check the client is attaching the Authorization header correctly
candidateFixes.tradeoff: Could be a smoke-test harness bug, not the app — verify before touching app code.

candidateFixes.label: Review the recent auth middleware change for a regression
candidateFixes.tradeoff: Real code review needed; ask before editing.

signal: A call expected to succeed with the smoke-test account was rejected as forbidden (authenticated but not permitted).
likelyCauses: Smoke-test fixture account lacks the role/permission the endpoint now requires
A permissions/RBAC change tightened access without updating the fixture account
Resource ownership check failing against a fixture that doesn't own the target record

candidateFixes.label: Grant the smoke-test fixture account the needed role/permission
candidateFixes.tradeoff: Config/fixture-data change, not application code — confirm the correct role first.

candidateFixes.label: Review the recent authorization-logic change for a regression
candidateFixes.tradeoff: Real code review needed; ask before editing.

signal: A route the smoke config marked as critical returned 404 instead of succeeding.
likelyCauses: Route path changed/renamed and config wasn't updated
Route genuinely removed/broken by a recent change
Wrong base URL/API version prefix in smoke-config.json

candidateFixes.label: Update smoke-config.json's path to match the current route
candidateFixes.tradeoff: Zone A change, if the route just moved — fine for this skill to edit itself.

candidateFixes.label: Restore the missing route in the backend
candidateFixes.tradeoff: Zone B change — needs explicit approval.

candidateFixes.label: Confirm the correct base URL/API version with the user
candidateFixes.tradeoff: Quick check, no change yet.

signal: Browser blocked the frontend-to-backend call due to CORS policy.
likelyCauses: Backend CORS allow-list doesn't include this frontend origin
Preflight (OPTIONS) not handled for this route
Environment-specific origin (e.g. staging domain) missing from config
Cross-check against a configuration-mismatch finding from patterns/configuration.json — it may already explain this

candidateFixes.label: Add this origin to the backend's CORS allow-list
candidateFixes.tradeoff: Zone B config/code change on backend — confirm the exact origin string first.

candidateFixes.label: Verify OPTIONS preflight handling for the route
candidateFixes.tradeoff: Deeper backend check, may reveal a separate bug.

candidateFixes.label: Use a proxy in the frontend dev/test setup instead of changing backend CORS
candidateFixes.tradeoff: Avoids touching backend but only fixes local/dev testing, not real deployments.

regex: EADDRINUSE|address already in use|port is already allocated
signal: The service couldn't bind because another process already holds the port.
likelyCauses: A previous instance of the service is still running
Another unrelated process is using the same port
Port misconfigured to collide with another service

candidateFixes.label: Stop the stale process holding the port and retry
candidateFixes.tradeoff: No code change; safe if it really is a leftover process.

candidateFixes.label: Change the configured port for this service
candidateFixes.tradeoff: Zone B config change — confirm the new port won't collide elsewhere.

signal: A call didn't complete within the expected time.
likelyCauses: Downstream dependency (DB, third-party API) is slow or hanging
Deadlock or blocking call on the request path
Smoke-test timeout threshold too low for this environment

candidateFixes.label: Increase the smoke-test timeout threshold if this environment is just slower
candidateFixes.tradeoff: Zone A change in smoke-config.json — safe for this skill to adjust itself.

candidateFixes.label: Investigate the slow downstream dependency
candidateFixes.tradeoff: Deeper dig; flag as blocked if time-boxed.

candidateFixes.label: Add a timeout/circuit-breaker around the slow call in app code
candidateFixes.tradeoff: Zone B code change — needs approval.

regex: npm ERR!|Module not found|Cannot find module|Failed to compile|vite.*error|ModuleNotFoundError
signal: Frontend or backend build/dev-server failed to start — nothing downstream can be tested until this is fixed.
likelyCauses: Dependency not installed / lockfile out of sync
Import path typo or a file that was moved/renamed
Environment variable required at build time is missing

candidateFixes.label: Run a clean install (delete node_modules/venv, reinstall from lockfile)
candidateFixes.tradeoff: No source change; fixes dependency drift issues.

candidateFixes.label: Fix the specific import/module path named in the error
candidateFixes.tradeoff: Zone B source fix — confirm the exact file before editing.

candidateFixes.label: Set the missing build-time env var
candidateFixes.tradeoff: Config-only, if that's the actual cause.

regex: Something went wrong|Uncaught Error|React will try to recreate|ErrorBoundary|Minified React error #\d+
signal: The React app crashed into an error boundary instead of rendering the expected screen.
likelyCauses: Unhandled exception in a component (often a null/undefined access)
A prop/shape contract with the backend changed
A third-party library version mismatch

candidateFixes.label: Fix the null/undefined access named in the console trace
candidateFixes.tradeoff: Zone B source fix — confirm the exact component/line before editing.

candidateFixes.label: Add a guard/loading state for the data that's arriving in an unexpected shape
candidateFixes.tradeoff: Zone B code change; improves robustness beyond just this bug.

candidateFixes.label: Pin/align the third-party library version if this followed a dependency bump
candidateFixes.tradeoff: Config/lockfile change — confirm which version to pin.

regex: Cannot GET /|404.*(page|route) not found|No routes matched location
signal: A frontend route the smoke config marked critical didn't resolve to any page.
likelyCauses: Route was renamed/removed in the router config
Server-side routing/rewrite rules missing for this SPA route
smoke-config.json path doesn't match the current router

candidateFixes.label: Update smoke-config.json to the current route path
candidateFixes.tradeoff: Zone A change, if the route just moved — fine for this skill to edit itself.

candidateFixes.label: Add the missing SPA fallback/rewrite rule on the server
candidateFixes.tradeoff: Zone B infra/config change — confirm before applying.

candidateFixes.label: Restore the route in the router config
candidateFixes.tradeoff: Zone B application code change — needs approval.

signal: An unhandled Python exception surfaced during the request/flow.
likelyCauses: The specific exception type/message names the root cause directly
Missing null/None check before an attribute or index access
Type mismatch between expected and actual data

candidateFixes.label: Fix the specific line/exception named in the traceback
candidateFixes.tradeoff: Zone B source fix — quote the exact traceback tail before editing.

candidateFixes.label: Add input validation before the point of failure
candidateFixes.tradeoff: Broader Zone B robustness change, not just a one-line fix.

candidateFixes.label: Catch and return a clean error response instead of crashing
candidateFixes.tradeoff: Improves failure mode; doesn't address root cause alone.

signal: An unhandled Java exception (often NPE) surfaced during the request/flow.
likelyCauses: Object expected to be initialized was null at the failure point
Optional/Autowired dependency not injected in this environment
Config value missing, leaving a field null

candidateFixes.label: Fix the specific null access named in the stack trace
candidateFixes.tradeoff: Zone B source fix — quote the top of the stack trace before editing.

candidateFixes.label: Add a null-check/Optional guard at that point
candidateFixes.tradeoff: Zone B code change, improves robustness beyond this one path.

candidateFixes.label: Verify the missing config/bean is set for this environment
candidateFixes.tradeoff: Config-only, if that's the actual gap.

signal: Token validation failed — either the token or the verifying secret/key is wrong.
likelyCauses: JWT secret/key mismatch between issuer and verifier (e.g. different envs)
Test token genuinely expired
Clock skew between services

candidateFixes.label: Re-issue a fresh smoke-test token and retry
candidateFixes.tradeoff: No code change; only fixes it if the token was simply stale.

candidateFixes.label: Align the JWT secret/key across services for this environment
candidateFixes.tradeoff: Config/secret change — confirm the correct value first.

candidateFixes.label: Check for clock skew between services
candidateFixes.tradeoff: Infra-level check, no code change.

signal: A call was rate-limited rather than genuinely failing.
likelyCauses: Smoke suite is running too many requests too fast against a rate-limited endpoint
Shared test environment being hit by other processes too

candidateFixes.label: Add a short delay between requests in the smoke run
candidateFixes.tradeoff: Smoke-harness change, not app code — safe to adjust.

candidateFixes.label: Whitelist the smoke-test source IP/key against the rate limiter
candidateFixes.tradeoff: Zone B config change on the rate-limiting layer — confirm before applying.
